title: Kissed Vietnamese Broad Beans Che Ba Mau
description: Fermented broad bean topping on sticky rice shaped like nigiri, served on a wooden board for a juicy post-workout snack.
instructions: Cook sticky rice in water until soft, then drain and let cool to room temperature.
Rinse fermented broad beans thoroughly to remove excess salt.
Whisk fish sauce, sugar, and lime juice together, then mix in the beans to create a quick fermented bean sauce.
Spread a thin layer of the bean sauce over the cooled sticky rice on a wooden board, forming small oval shapes.
Add a spoonful of bean sauce atop each rice oval to keep the beans juicy.
Arrange carrot, cucumber, and mint slices over the bean topping for texture and freshness.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the garnish for aroma and crunch.
Refrigerate the board for 10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
